note: What the fuzz tier is allowed to find in the categories that are not server-side defects.
See the header of tools/ci/fuzz-verdict.mjs for why each of these is tracked rather than gating.
A budget is a ratchet: lower it in the same commit that earns the drop, never raise it to make a
red run green. The gating categories are not listed here and are allowed nothing.
Schemathesis generates from a fresh seed every run, so these counts move by a few either way.
Observed on 2026-09-11 across five runs, the last two after ValidationFailureResponsesCustomizer
declared the 400 that 221 operations can actually return:
rejected schema-compliant      106, 104, 131, 132   (rose when two 500s became the 400s they
always were: the same cases, correctly classified)
undocumented status code       101, 96, 158, 38     (158 was the same move, before the document
caught up; 38 is what is left, and it is the real number)
The budgets sit about 15% above the highest of those: tight enough that closing a real batch
shows up as headroom to give back, loose enough that a new seed alone cannot turn the tier red.
